core_obligations: Check the faithful flatness condition (proof lines 2742-2744): for an etale covering {phi_i : U_i -> U}, each phi_i is flat because it is etale, and the members cover U by definition of a covering, so the family is faithfully flat.

Check the quasi-compactness condition (proof lines 2745-2750): for an affine open V of U, write each preimage phi_i^{-1}(V) as a union of affine opens V_{ij}; since etale morphisms are open, V is the union of the images phi_i(V_{ij}).
Conclude (proof lines 2751-2752): since V is quasi-compact, that open covering of V admits a finite refinement, which is exactly the quasi-compactness requirement of an fpqc covering.
proof_roadmap: Etale morphisms are flat and the family covers, giving faithful flatness.
For an affine open of the target, express it as a union of images of affine opens from the sources using openness of etale morphisms.
Quasi-compactness of the affine open turns this into a finite refinement.
Hence the etale covering is an fpqc covering.
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that every etale covering is an fpqc covering (statement lines 2733-2736). The proof verifies the two defining properties separately: faithful flatness is immediate from flatness and the covering condition (proof lines 2742-2744), while the quasi-compactness requirement needs an argument, namely writing an affine open V of the target as a union of images of affine opens of the sources using openness of etale morphisms, and then invoking quasi-compactness of V to extract a finite refinement (proof lines 2745-2752). The content is the second verification, where openness of etale morphisms is the non-formal input. The claim is H2: two short verifications, one of them with a genuine refinement step.
